    External MCP Server Catalog - Sweep Log, October 1-15, 2026¶

    Archive for October 1-15, 2026. Discovery passes appear newest first. The current sweep log carries the most recent passes.

    Archive: September 16-31, 2026 | October 16-31, 2026

    🆕 October 15, 2026 - Evening Sweep (2 New, 2 Guides)¶

    Evening sweep about 11 hours after the October 15 midday sweep: the mcp.so /feed (30 server links via the direct TanStack fetch; the newest card 19:04 MST, with SoChain, Radikabunavi, ProLevelMax, Default Privacy, Soundza, Social Growth Engineers, Shortimize, Layro, MySSAgent Social Security Claiming Estimator, InstaBids, Mark agent escrow, Sleek, Reweb and Pexafy Stock Photos fresh past the midday capture), mcpservers.org /all pages 1-5 through the r.jina.ai reader proxy (146 slugs), the fresh chatmcp/mcpso issue window #5458-#5491 (34 numbers, all live), and a fresh twelve-sitemap canonical refresh (r122: 15,835 EN server URLs; 212 additions and 2 removals against the r121 capture), with vendor docs, live endpoint probes and class-precedent passes for every candidate. Two new business-relevant entries, each catalogued with a guide: the full U.S. DOL Form 5500 retirement and welfare plan filing set, and a cited price book for the AI training data market.

    • Form 5500 MCP - US Retirement Plan Filings in Chat · free keyless Streamable HTTP at https://5500mcp.ai/mcp (no account, no key): nine tools over every filed DOL Form 5500 and 5500-SF plan - search by sponsor, EIN, state, plan type or size, read one plan's filed profile, rank plans by a filed metric, walk a plan's filing history, compare cohorts by percentile with a chart, and run eight guided skills (Form 5500 literacy, plan fee benchmark, plan diligence brief, fee transparency report, compliance flag scan, committee review inputs, verify a plan claim, plan prospecting screen). Reporting is as-filed by construction: every value is a filed figure or a computed percentile over the filed population, labelled, and the server forbids estimating or imputing a figure a plan did not file. Publisher: 5500mcp (vintage 2026-09-03, updated daily; listed in the WealthMCP retirement index). Live probe: keyless initialize returns 200 as 5500mcp v1.0.0 and tools/list returns all nine tools.
    • AIData.Broker MCP - AI Training Data Prices and Deals · free read-only Streamable HTTP at https://aidata.broker/mcp (no account, no key; every tool flagged read-only): the cited price book for the AI data market - market rates by kind of data and side of market, the individual published price observations behind them, a low-to-high value range for a comparable holding with the arithmetic shown, buyers and their published terms, vendors, the licensing deals disclosed to AI companies since July 2023, the lawsuits and rulings over AI training data, and what a named business system's terms (Slack, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Zoom, GitHub and others) allow. Datasets are open under CC BY 4.0. Live probe: keyless initialize returns 200 as AIData.Broker v2026.10.14 and tools/list returns all nine read-only tools.

    Also identified (not catalogued): on the mcp.so /feed (30 links; the newest card 19:04 MST), evaluated and held beside the two catalogued entries: SoChain (chain data; crypto class), Radikabunavi MCP (Japanese retail-investor signals; regional finance utility), ProLevelMax (creator growth utility), Default Privacy (privacy utility), Soundza (audio utility), Shortimize (short-link and media utility), Social Growth Engineers (short-form growth research, hooks and playbooks plus live App Store data over OAuth 2.1; the social-data and creator-research classes are dense per the catalogued Octolens entry and the InsightSocial hold), Layro (design utility), MySSAgent Social Security Claiming Estimator (consumer retirement tools, the Gigaverse disposition), InstaBids (contractor and project bidding; the local-services class per the catalogued RemodelerIQ and Hirenimbus entries), Mark: agent escrow (agent-payments class per the steward-mcp and Mekler dispositions), Sleek and Reweb (design and rebuild utilities) and Pexafy Stock Photos (consumer stock media), with litshrine, CardsNearby, Ranla, Articos and hedwigai carrying their October 14 dispositions and the remaining cards (fixRAgent, ProfessionalHeadshot.io, PostPlanify, Blend MCP, DatePhotos.AI, UGCfy AI, Adgentek Ad Server, Pitch Protocol, The Living Bread, Logimu Shopping) repeats from the October 13-15 ledgers. On mcpservers.org /all pages 1-5 (146 slugs), the fresh cohort resolved to prior dispositions and class holds: Marketing MCP by Honeyfield (agent-run marketing across Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Tag Manager, Business Profile, Clarity, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, WordPress and Strapi with per-workspace roles and an approval gate before every change; business-relevant, but no hosted MCP endpoint could be verified - /mcp, /api/mcp and the app host all 404 or redirect to a 404, so it is held until an endpoint is discoverable), App Store Review Intelligence (App Store and Google Play review mining; distributed as an Apify actor, the Apify-distribution hold class per Metqo Data), Scrupp email finder (lead-data class dense per Crustdata, EnvoAPI and the LeadBoxer hold), MyFinance (consumer finance per the consumer PF ledger), RetailIntel (regional retail news-API cluster), WealthMCP (a 217-server index of wealth-tech MCP servers; the meta-index class per the Agent Data Co and AgentAtlas holds), StackSpend (cloud and AI cost analytics and anomaly triage; adjacent to the catalogued Vertice SaaS-spend entry), MainWP (single-vendor WordPress dashboard connector; the single-vendor-platform rule), Heard (cloud-agent voice reports on the Mac; held October 8, device-utility class), DBine (desktop multi-engine database manager; dev utility), PRRO Cloud (Ukrainian fiscal cash-register API for developers; geo-niche class) and the remainder of the four pages as repeats from the October 12-15 ledgers (the saifs-ai family, the mambalabsdev job-change trio, the CloudCorpRecords contributor fleet, PremiumPin, searxNcrawl, SVG.new, fieldtwin, Deputy, Clubhouse shells and the username, locale and leftover remainder). From the fresh chatmcp/mcpso issue window #5458-#5491 (34 numbers), all held beyond the two catalogued entries: Jobbi Agent Gigs (agent gig marketplace), Visual Sentinel (website monitoring; the uptime and monitoring class per RealUptime and Monitly), TheySaid, WebTwizz, Soldgraph, AI Benchmark Index (meta utility), research-scope-mcp (research-to-report workflow; docs-RAG utility), Liquid Compute GPU Test, Wishblock, Valor AI, NoBounce email validation (email-verification trio, commodity class), Agent Cost Log, Run Budget Guard and Approval Rules (agent-governance utilities; the agent-infrastructure and guard classes per AegisCore and Agentguard), searxNcrawl (scraping class saturated), PremiumPin Property Records (property-data class), ATS Zero-Browser Gateway and ATS Job Board Feeds (Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby postings; the jobs-data and careers classes per CareJobs.Now, Applystead and RobotTraining.jobs), Mifori CertAgent, singularis-mcp, google-hotels-mcp (consumer travel), Mandala Computer (cloud desktops for agents; agent-infrastructure class), Handoff Watch, Run Memory, Loop Breaker, creaper (REAPER DAW; creative utility) and the already-dispositioned SpendGate, PayCheck, Toolweather, Upstream, Signal Leads, Agent Wake and Agent Access Check. Canonical window check (r121 to r122: 212 additions, 2 removals): the additions were dominated by the mid-October ingestion wave - the rapidapi-com-olly utility kit (sixteen single-purpose API wrappers), the m-pineapple and gmcfuerte plugin fleets, the nikhonit social-media-api-skills set, the wrpbr and toolweather utility sets, the profitpather and quarterlytax shells - with the business-relevant names beyond the two catalogued entries (Marketing MCP by Honeyfield, App Store Review Intelligence, Scrupp, MyFinance, RetailIntel, WealthMCP, StackSpend, MainWP, AIData.Broker and 5500mcp) all held or catalogued above.

    🆕 October 15, 2026 - Midday Sweep (1 New, 1 Guide)¶

    Midday sweep about 13 hours after the October 14 evening sweep: the mcp.so /feed (30 server links via the r.jina.ai reader proxy; two cards fresh past the evening capture - The Living Bread and Logimu Shopping), mcpservers.org /all pages 1-5 through the r.jina.ai reader proxy (145 slugs; the delta against the evening capture was 91 slugs, 62 of them members of the r120 canonical addition wave the evening sweep already dispositioned by name, with the rest resolving to 404 shells, author paths and class holds), the fresh chatmcp/mcpso issue window #5428-#5457 (30 numbers), and a fresh twelve-sitemap canonical refresh (r121: 15,625 server URLs; six additions and zero removals against the r120 capture), with vendor docs, live endpoint probes and class-precedent passes for every candidate. One new business-relevant entry, catalogued with a guide: the accounts-receivable layer for Xero and QuickBooks Online.

    • Paidnice MCP - Accounts Receivable for Xero and QuickBooks · hosted Streamable HTTP at https://api.paidnice.com/mcp (OAuth 2.1; sign in and choose the organization and access): the receivables layer of the finance stack - Xero or QuickBooks holds the ledger, Paidnice holds what happens after the invoice goes out, and the assistant reads both in one chat. It triages customer replies into promises, questions and disputes ranked by what each account owes, checks whether a "we already paid" claim landed as a payment or a deposit waiting to be reconciled, briefs you before a call and keeps contacts current from cc lines and out-of-office replies. The beta set adds the multi-client accountant path, a month-end pack with DSO, overdue and collected per client, a cash forecast, an approval queue for drafted reminders and statements, and escalation work surfaces. Publisher: Paidnice (Xero Global App Awards 2026 App of the Year; Pro and Custom plans include the server). Live probe: POST initialize to api.paidnice.com/mcp returns 401 for the OAuth flow (official registry com.paidnice/mcp v1.0.0; vendor docs live).

    Also identified (not catalogued): the two feed cards fresh past the evening capture were The Living Bread (Bible passages with an evidence label and cross references; the novelty and consumer-content rule) and Logimu Shopping MCP (Amazon across eleven marketplaces plus Walmart US product data with ranked search, prices, stock, sellers, the Buy Box and price and sales-rank history; the e-commerce product-data class is covered by the catalogued Datrace, Pangolinfo and AMZ Vault entries and the Ecommerce Data API hold), with every other feed card carrying a prior disposition from the October 13-14 ledgers. On mcpservers.org /all pages 1-5, the 91-slug delta over the evening capture was 62 members of the r120 canonical addition wave already dispositioned by name, and the remainder resolved to 404 shells and author or account paths (petshopbros, transcenduk, expeditedprojects, elicitly, beppetemp, idos-games, iamsal, officialspicrawl, cbecks1212, bradraylucas-eng, murphywuwu, norcalnappy, punsnprotons, random00000000, lordfreez-ship-it, conorbronsdon) and to class holds: Catchr (agency marketing reporting across 100+ sources; the cross-channel marketing class is dense per the catalogued Blend MCP and Get Ads entries), Fixter (APM and error tracking for agent-built apps; dev-infrastructure class), Nifty PM (tasks, projects and docs; workspace and PM class per the catalogued Monday.com, Notion and Taskade entries), PostEverywhere (social publishing across twelve networks; the social-publishing class is at saturation per Pith and PostPlanify), CarWhere VIN (VIN decode, NHTSA recalls and buyer pricing; the vehicle-data class per CarDossier and Dutch Vehicle Context), CloudCorpRecords (contributor-tool fleet), InsightSocial (social-data density), Elfsight (site widgets; consumer utility) and Polymarket Wallets (crypto class). From the fresh chatmcp/mcpso issue window #5428-#5457 (30 numbers), all held beyond the catalogued entry: Clarity Today (tech news; news class), Citepath (self-hosted cited documentation search; docs-RAG utility), Lomen (cookie-free website analytics with Stripe, Shopify, Lemon Squeezy and Polar revenue; the analytics class per the catalogued Umami entry), OpenSDR (open-source AI SDR on your own keys; lead-data class dense), Brandname Maker (naming with registry domain checks; creative-novelty utility), Upstream (live API status and breaking-change digests; the status class per APIzone, HostTracker, Drumbeats and pingcheck), MnogoReels (long video to captioned shorts; media-generation class), China News Feed (regional news and hot lists over an Apify actor;     Integration with CorpusIQ¶

    CorpusIQ is the connector layer that lets AI assistants read the systems a business already runs on - accounting, payments, CRM, email, files and analytics - and answer with the source named. It is read-only by design: it retrieves data and never writes to, or acts in, a connected system, which is what makes it safe to point at live accounts.

    This page is part of the CorpusIQ directory, the reference we maintain for the MCP server and agent-skill ecosystem. Run alongside CorpusIQ, a third-party server like this one can be combined with a company's own business data in a single answer.
